objective: Deliberate operator control of the intended original player without replay after reconnect or uncertain delivery

publication.transport: Authorized GitHub connector create_commit and non-force update_ref; no Render Git credentials copied or provisioned

exactContentBinding.meaning: The published source files are exactly the already-tested merge/registry source. The original receipt keeps its original commit identity. This is content-equivalence reuse, not a new run.

preserved: shared HTTP server and WebSocket attachment

nativeEvidenceScope.previousEvidence: Historical 14 generated-PowerShell checks and two-process crash/restart case described in PR249 comment 5747167848 remain bounded historical evidence for unchanged native source.
nativeEvidenceScope.limitation: A source comparison is not execution of the new checkout, not full CMD startup coverage, and not observation of an installed player.

reconstruction.method: Isolated helper prefix/suffix ancestor and GitHub's computed merge object recovered the already-tested complete tree. The published commit was separately created with only the real two source parents. Helper trees are not runtime candidates and must not be built or deployed.

remainingBoundary.required: Permitted Windows booth/original-player execution access and an actual authorized operator session
remainingBoundary.next: Execute native outer CMD startup and an operator-originated command through Sway to the selected original player; observe target state independently, preserve uncertainty, reconnect without redispatch, and verify explicit review permits only a genuinely new command.
doNotRepeat: provider-independent fixtures as a substitute for real playback
